_comment: Single source of truth for the pi-ai provider-cost patch (harness cost issue H1). Consumed by pi-provider-cost-patch.ts (the runner image and the in-process engine, via scripts/patch-pi-provider-cost.ts) AND by services/runner/images/sandbox/daytona/build_snapshot.py (the Daytona snapshot, which installs Pi from npm). Both surfaces MUST patch identically, or a Daytona Pi run reports Pi's price-table estimate while a local run reports the billed charge. Keep the anchor and the injected function here and nowhere else.
